title: Modified Run-Length Encoding

attempts.result: Resolver error: Type parameters of measure same_head must be the same as in the datatype declaration.
attempts.disposition: Corrected by introducing RleList a so each measure's final datatype argument carries that datatype's own parameter list.

attempts.result: Resolver error: Predicate or measure inc is undefined.
attempts.disposition: Corrected in contract.sq by replacing the executable-only inc reference in the logical measure with built-in arithmetic n + 1. No third attempt was run: the item limit is two reasoned attempts.

final_contract_validation: The retained contract.sq incorporates the second correction but was not submitted for a third run, by design. It is therefore a full source-level contract awaiting a later bounded validation/synthesis invocation, not a synthesized candidate.
semantic_obligations: Encode the unique maximal left-to-right partition of the input into nonempty adjacent-equality runs.
Emit One x if and only if that run's length is exactly 1.
Emit Many (n, x) if and only if that run's length is n >= 2.
Preserve complete input order, each run boundary, and multiplicity; never merge separated equal values.
Retain exact stated public OCaml signature: type 'a rle = One of 'a | Many of int * 'a; encode : 'a list -> 'a rle list.
required_features: Parametric algebraic datatypes and structural recursion.
Datatype-valued first-order logical measures and equality over those values.
A trusted generic equality decision for arbitrary element values.
Integer arithmetic sufficient for run-count promotion.

test_evidence.scope: official example; empty/singleton/all-equal/mixed-boundary edge cases; exhaustive ternary inputs through length 6; deliberately incorrect negative-control expectation
test_evidence.negative_control_stub: An explicitly labelled failwith "unsynthesized" stub compiled against the test file and exited 2 with Failure("unsynthesized"), demonstrating the suite rejects an absent implementation.

candidate_claim: None. There is no synthesized or manually authored final OCaml implementation in this item.
